description: Simulate people who arrive from an ad (image, video or copy), land on a page, and take one of several exits (for example book a consultation, open the plan form, or leave). Reports the exit split per arm. Pass rewrites to compare a changed ad and page copy against the original on the same audience. The first call quotes the cost and starts nothing; call again with accept_cost true once the user agrees. Collect results with aetherya_get_result kind 'flow'. Results are SIMULATED, not real-user data.

accept_cost.description: Leave unset on the first call: nothing starts and the quote comes back. Set true only after the user agrees to the quoted cost.

ads.description: 0-2 ads. Each simulated visitor sees one ad first; with two, they are split across them.

asset_id.description: An image or video already uploaded and read through the Read card. The ad is then what that read described (image: its description; video: speech and on-screen text only). Use instead of description.

description.description: The ad's copy, or what the image or video shows and says. Give this or asset_id.

kind.description: What the ad is. asset_id needs image or video.

label.description: Short name for the ad, e.g. 'Spring carousel'.

audience.description: Optional. A synthetic audience: a persona id or name from aetherya_list_audiences, or a short free-text description (e.g. 'first-time SaaS buyers').

exits.description: 1-4 ways the visit can end. A visitor takes the first exit whose signal matches, or leaves. Give at least one signal per exit: form_contains (most reliable), url_contains or text_visible.

form_contains.description: Words found only in this exit's form or on its final button (not in the other exit's form), e.g. 'Phone' or 'Generate my plan'. The most reliable signal.

label.description: What this exit is, e.g. 'Book a consultation'.

primary.description: The exit that matters most. One exit should be primary; the first is used if none is.

text_visible.description: Text that appears only after this exit, e.g. a confirmation message.

url_contains.description: Part of the thank-you URL, e.g. '/thank-you'.

num_agents.description: Simulated visitors per arm. Default 6. Each arm runs this many, and the ads are split round-robin across them. Cost is quoted per arm.

page_url.description: The landing page the ads send people to.

rewrites.description: Adds a second arm, 'rewrite', run against the same audience as 'original'. Give ads and/or page_copy.

ads.description: Same order and count as ads. Each replaces that ad's description in the rewrite arm.

asset_id.description: An image or video already uploaded and read through the Read card. The ad is then what that read described (image: its description; video: speech and on-screen text only). Use instead of description.

description.description: The rewritten ad copy or visual description.

label.description: Optional. Defaults to the original ad's label.
Name for the rewrite arm. Default 'rewrite'.

page_copy.description: Text swaps applied to the landing page in the rewrite arm only.

name: aetherya_test_flow

estimatedPercentMax.description: Plan share for all arms, high end.

estimatedPercentMin.description: Plan share for all arms, low end.

title: Test which exit an ad and landing page drive people to
